pages.lesson:
LESSON: READING 1.4.1 INTENSIVE READING: TRICKSTER NARRATIVES

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.4: Reading 1.4.1 Intensive Reading: Trickster Narratives

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Reading 1.4.1 Intensive Reading: Trickster Narratives. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why would we listen to trickster narratives?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the main events in trickster narratives

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify the main events in trickster narratives
   In simple words: practise until you can identify the main events in trickster narratives. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Reading 1.4.1 Intensive Reading: Trickster Narratives using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Reading 1.4.1 Intensive Reading: Trickster Narratives in the examples.
2. Explain Reading 1.4.1 Intensive Reading: Trickster Narratives to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Reading 1.4.1 Intensive Reading: Trickster Narratives.
4. Show that you can: identify the main events in trickster narratives

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading 1.4.1 Intensive Reading: Trickster Narratives using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Reading 1.4.1 Intensive Reading: Trickster Narratives important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Engage in pre-reading activities such as previewing the title of the narrative, using picture clues, and brainstorming,
2. Discuss the various character traits displayed by the characters,

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify the main events in trickster narratives

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
